description: This file contains the localization strings in Hindi for the Select2 jQuery plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines messages displayed during various user interactions such as loading results, errors, and input validation.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when results fail to load.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Informs the user to remove a certain number of characters when input exceeds the maximum allowed.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Prompts the user to input more characters if the input is shorter than the minimum required.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Displays a message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Informs the user they have reached the maximum number of selectable items.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Displays when no matching results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Indicates the search operation is in progress.
